title: What are the benefits of the Enterprise plan?
snippet:
The Enterprise plan is a flat fee ($3,999 per month billed monthly, or $3,199 per month billed annually) that includes 80 agents.

## No plan limits
The Enterprise plan has no plan limits on:
- departments
- email accounts
- chat buttons
- contact forms
- canned messages and predefined answers
- event rules, time rules and SLA rules
- custom roles
- API keys
- custom ticket filters
- WhatsApp numbers and Telegram bots
- AI agents
## Also included
- 10 knowledge bases.
- All features, including the call center, reporting, SSO, audit log, department roles and branding removal.
- The MCP server, so you can connect LiveAgent to external AI tools such as Claude.
- A dedicated account manager, priority support, service review calls and reports, custom billing setup and scheduled release management.

title: LiveAgent Affiliate Program - Terms and Conditions
snippet:
- **Partner**: Any entity or individual partaking in the LiveAgent Partnership Program.
- **Basic Partner**: A partner satisfying the requirements of the Basic level.
- **Advanced Partner**: A partner satisfying the requirements of the Advanced level.
- **Professional Partner**: A partner satisfying the requirements of the Professional level.

## Partnership Levels and Requirements
| | Basic | Advanced | Professional |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Expectations** | | | |
| Yearly commission | up to 1000 | up to 5000 | more than 5000 |
| Minimal accounts sold yearly | 2 | 3 | 5 |
| Minimal account lifetime needed / months | 3 | 3 | 3 |
| Provision limit | 12 months | 12 months | 12 months |
| Actively promote LiveAgent | not mandatory | | |
| Partner and sales training | not mandatory | | |
| Inactivity limit | 12 months | 12 months | 12 months |
| Fixed cost | 8% | 8% | 8% |
| **Benefits** | | | |
| Referral commission | 10% | 20% | 30% |
| LiveAgent partner logo | LiveAgent Basic partner | LiveAgent Advanced partner | LiveAgent Pro partner |
| Sponsored Demo accounts | 0 | 1 | 3 |
| Dedicated [customer support](/customer-service-software/) contact | | | |
| Access to the prerelease list | | | |
| Marketing cooperative activities | | | |
### Basic Partner
- **Commission**: Up to 1000 EUR annually.
- **Sales Requirement**: Minimum of 2 accounts sold yearly.
- **Account Activity**: Each account must be active for at least 3 months.
- **Commission Rate**: 10%.
**Additional Features:**
- No mandatory promotion of LiveAgent.
- No sponsored demo accounts.
- General customer support is available.
- No access to pre-release lists or cooperative marketing activities.
### Advanced Partner
- **Commission**: Up to 5000 EUR annually.
- **Sales Requirement**: Minimum of 3 accounts sold yearly.
- **Account Activity**: Each account must be active for at least 3 months.
- **Commission Rate**: 20%.
**Additional Features:**
- Mandatory promotion through a microsite, social media, or newsletter.
- Use of LiveAgent Advanced Partner logo required.
- One demo account for testing updates.
- General customer support is available.
- Information on new releases via email one week in advance.
- Participation in cooperative marketing activities.

- **Sales Requirement**: Minimum of 5 accounts sold yearly.
- **Account Activity**: Each account must be active for at least 3 months.
- **Commission Rate**: 30%.

title: General
snippet: Customer: Is it possible to become a LiveAgent reseller? Answer: While we don't offer a traditional reseller program, you can earn commissions by promoting LiveAgent through our Partnership program (Affiliate program). It allows you to refer customers and receive a recurring commission for the accounts you bring in.

title: API features
snippet: LiveAgent’s API enables seamless software communication, supporting actions like company retrieval and conversation creation. Integrate with tools via Zapier, access resources like demos, and enhance customer support with features like collaboration tools and iOS app.
